title: Adoption of JEV Multi-Layer Agent Hierarchy
context: Automating complex industrial IDEs requires strict separation between high-level reasoning, Win32 interaction, and safety validation.
decision: Implement the JEV architecture: J (Jerarquía Orquestadora), E (Ejecución y Automatización), and V (Validación y Seguridad Fail-Closed).
consequences: Eliminates monolithic code paths and isolates GUI automation from simulation and security guards.

title: Fail-Closed Hardware Lockout & Physical Download Ban
context: Prevent accidental downloading of unverified code or disruption to physical plant controllers.
decision: Permanently block COM ports 1-256, companion flash utilities, and Win32 download command IDs (32827, 33149).
consequences: Automated processes can never alter physical PLC firmware; physical loading is strictly a manual engineering activity.

title: Single GUI Agent Boundary on Interactive Desktop winsta0\Default
context: Concurrent GUI manipulation in Windows causes focus stealing, clipboard collisions, and modal deadlocks.
decision: Only ONE agent process may drive Cscape Win32 HWNDs on winsta0\Default; all other agents run headlessly or perform read-only queries.
consequences: Ensures deterministic UI automation without race conditions or desktop corruption.

title: Pure ST Enforcement and Acknowledgment of BLOCKED_NATIVE ST->LD Reality
context: Cscape 10.2 maintains separate engines for Advanced Ladder and IEC 61131-3 ST, lacking any native conversion menus or exports.
decision: Strictly reject ladder constructs in .st POUs (ERR_LADDER_FORBIDDEN) and document ST->LD conversion as BLOCKED_NATIVE: DOCUMENT_ONLY.
consequences: Prevents invalid AST syntax in POUs and stops agents from attempting non-existent native GUI conversions.

title: Local-Only Git Repository Tracking Without Remote Push Targets
context: Project artifacts and local history must be cleanly versioned without exposing internal industrial files to public or unverified remotes.
decision: Initialize Git locally solely for audit trails and milestone commits with zero remotes configured.
consequences: Guarantees fail-closed isolation from unauthorized remote pushes.
